description: Signed-in policies in public that carry no request-tenant condition, each reviewed, pinned to its deparsed text and named with the package that ends it. The catalog gate (scripts/verify/tenant-rls-catalog.mjs) fails any other signed-in policy of a tenant table without the condition, a listed policy whose text changes (POLICY_EXCEPTION_CHANGED) and a listed policy that is gone (POLICY_EXCEPTION_STALE). See docs/security/tenant-policy-activation-review.md, section 3, and the coordinator's rulings of 19 November 2026 on its questions 3 and 4.

entries.reason: The requester's own claim rows. A claimant may hold no membership in the tenant yet, so a tenant condition would hide their own claim from them. An accepted earlier decision gave the requester this read and the frozen suite of issue 2255 pins it. The row shows the claimant donor_id, match_type, match_confidence and resolved_by. Nothing reads it on a signed-in token today.
entries.ends: WP5, which builds account claims and decides what a claimant sees

entries.using: (( SELECT authz.is_super_admin() AS is_super_admin) OR (((tenant_id IS NULL) OR (tenant_id = ( SELECT authz.current_tenant_id() AS current_tenant_id))) AND (( SELECT authz.current_tenant_id() AS current_tenant_id) IS NOT NULL)))
entries.reason: It carries the tenant condition and also admits the global rows (tenant_id IS NULL), which belong to no tenant, to a member of the active tenant: a donor row and a missionary row still read field_policies.
entries.ends: WP2c removes its super-admin branch; the global rows are permanent
